name: frost-toast-shadow-overlap
description: Measures the copy-confirmation toast's own widget bounds and, with two stacked, the shadow band between/around them. Corrects an earlier assumption that this toast lands bottom-left - the code and a first pass here both show it at the corner OPPOSITE the sidebar (top-right for a left sidebar). Long settles after each key press are deliberate: they give a concurrent AX probe (axresize list 0) room to catch the transient widget while it's up.
